body.p: After . Owns src/unicode.c, src/unicode_internal.h, src/unicode_tables.c, tools/generate-unicode-tables.py, src/function_library_unicode.c, tests/unicode_test.c. Unicode 16.0: canonical and compatibility decomposition and composition (NFC, NFD, NFKC, NFKD, FULLY-NORMALIZED as F&O allows), grapheme cluster breaks (UAX #29), the HTML5 character reference names for fn:char. Functions: normalize-unicode, graphemes, characters, char. The wasm size growth is logged. Done when fn-graphemes (918 cases), fn-normalize-unicode, fn-char, fn-characters ≥ 95%. Spec: F&O 4.0 per function; UAX #15, UAX #29. Done 2026-10-17 (): fn-graphemes 918/918, fn-normalize-unicode 39/41 (44/44 once the driver declares FULLY-NORMALIZED), fn-char 47/48 (char-001 needs fn:json-doc), fn-characters 8/8; all of Unicode 16.0 NormalizationTest.txt and GraphemeBreakTest.txt pass; wasm grows by about 143 KB (136 KB of tables).
